# Vendor V001, Supplier, active.
#
# Read into a book, and then again with `active: false`, which the test writes
# in: the vendor the book holds is active, and the file now says it is not.
#
# What this fixture produces: vendor V001, active.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_record_read_again_with_a_field_changed_is_updated.py.
vendor "V001"
	name: "Supplier"
	currency: CAD
	active: true
